versions.changelog:
bilibili-summary skill 1.0.0 — Initial release

- Supports the complete workflow for handling Bilibili (哔哩哔哩) video subtitles, including user login via QR code, automatic subtitle fetching (AI/CC, with fallback), summary generation, and keyword time-stamp lookup.
- Subtitles auto-cached locally; uses cache if available to save time and API calls.
- Provides clear instructions and CLI scripts for cookie login, subtitle fetching, and time-stamp searching.
- Designed to trigger for any request involving B 站视频/bilibili subtitles, summaries, or keyword location queries.
- Pure Python, minimally dependent (requests needed; qrcode optional).
- Gracefully handles missing/invalid cookies, videos with no subtitles, and network errors, with user guidance for each case.
